abstract: Adweek (December 1, 2025) coverage of Omnicom's post-IPG merger restructuring: 4,000 direct job cuts and the retirement of three storied creative networks — DDB, FCB, and MullenLowe. Combined post-merger headcount ~105,000, down ~18% from the 128,000 across Omnicom and IPG at end-2024. Creative structure consolidates around three global networks: BBDO, McCann, TBWA. Most redundancies fall during December 2025.
keyFindings: 4,000 direct job cuts following Omnicom-IPG merger completion (Nov 26, 2025)
DDB, FCB, MullenLowe agency brands retired
Creative structure consolidated into three global networks: BBDO, McCann, TBWA
methodology: Trade-press reporting on merger announcement and Omnicom leadership disclosures.
qualifiers: Cuts driven by merger consolidation and client-driven margin pressure — AI is one factor among several. Best framed as creative-industry workforce consolidation signal rather than AI-only displacement.
